01579 Gimzow {gim-zo:'}

字源不詳; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Gimzo 1; 1

瑾鎖 = "西克莫無花果樹, 桑樹"
1) 靠近非利士人的一座猶大城鎮 (#代下 28:18|)
record.edic_text:
01579 Gimzow {ghim-zo'}

of uncertain derivation;; n pr loc

AV - Gimzo 1; 1

Gimzo = "fertile in sycamores"
1) a town in Judah south of the road between Jerusalem and Joppa which
   with its dependant villages was captured by the Philistines in the
   reign of Ahaz
